name: Kneeling push-up (up, down, fully back up)
identity_reference: sprites/docs/PHOTOREALISTIC_AVATAR_DIRECTION_2026-11-25.md; same Chart 1 photo identity master, not a descendant of another video

camera.description: Fixed 90-degree side profile, full body in frame on red running track, no camera movement

rules: One realistic normal 12–14-year-old boy with unchanged face, hair, outfit, body length and setting
Both palms and both knees remain firmly planted on their original track marks for the full clip
Both elbows bend and straighten together, shoulder to hip to knee remains a continuous line
Per the original Chart 1 booklet, a completed repetition requires the CHEST to touch the floor gently at its low point; do not substitute chin contact or an incomplete hover
Lower legs remain bent behind planted knees; no toe-supported plank and no raised knees
After reaching the low point, return the ENTIRE torso and head to the original straight-elbow start pose
Continuous real body motion; no fades, still-image dissolves, ghost arms, cuts or camera moves

phases.pose: Begin at kneeling push-up top, palms and knees planted, both elbows extended, torso aligned
Both elbows bend together; shoulders, head and trunk descend as one aligned body toward a gentle chest-floor touch
Reach the low point with chest gently touching the track to complete the movement; chin and forehead remain clear, no impact
Return head, torso and both elbows fully to the identical top posture, with hands and knees unmoved
